en: The Triplet on Limited Objects (Parittārammaṇattika), the Dyad on Roots (Hetuduka).
Dependent on a state that is limited in its object and a cause, there arises a state that is not limited in its object and is not a cause, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are twenty-one; under object condition, nine ... pe ... under mutuality condition, thirteen ... pe ... under result condition, seventeen ... pe ...

Dependent on a state with limited object that is not-root, there arises a state with exalted object that is not-root, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
